name: DrownedMill
collider: piles+bearing post: capsules/boxes; deck: one box (top at z=2.41); house walls: box; roof: 2 sloped boxes; braces, railing rails, drips, moss: no collider (railing posts optional). No ladder/stairs: the deck and the roof are reachable only via cards; keep diagonal braces without colliders so they are not a climbing route.
moving_parts: water wheel = separate FBX SM_SW20_DrownedMillWheel (separate prefab child); put its pivot at wheel_mount_xyz_m (Blender X right, Y back, Z up, relative to the mill pivot) = wheel_mount_unity_guess (standard Unity FBX import: X mirrored, Blender Y -> -Z, Z -> Y; verify once against the bearing block under the +X deck edge, where the axle stub ends). Spin around the wheel local X axis (axle); paddles dip ~0.6 m below the water line.
wheel_gap_to_mill_m: wheel inner face (local x=-0.42) is 0.24 m from the bearing post, ~0.6 m from the deck edge, ~1.7 m from the house wall, ~0.15 m horizontal clearance under the lean-to eave; axle stub ends inside the bearing block
notes: Front (-Y) = door + window + gable window, railing walkway on the front and -X side; porch with lean-to roof and the wheel on +X. Water line at the moss collars of the stilts. Pivot = bottom of the stilts, XY centred on the mill (without the wheel).

name: DrownedMillWheel
collider: none or one thin cylinder; it spins
pivot: axle centre (0,0,0), axle along local X
notes: 12 rim segments x2, 10 spokes per side, 23 soling boards (one missing, two broken), 12 paddles, octagonal hub with iron bands, axle stub reaching the bearing block on the mill.
